content: Semantics of DiagnosticEnableConditionPortMapping A DiagnosticEnableConditionPortMapping defines which SWC service port(s) have to be connected to which DiagnosticEnableCondition . This is real- ized by defining a DiagnosticEnableConditionPortMapping referencing a Di- agnosticEnableCondition and an instance of SwcServiceDependency .
